name: prosa
description: Start or join a Prosa conversation with one shared URL, in this Claude session.

prosaUrl.title: Prosa server (for new conversations)
prosaUrl.description: Leave empty for the hosted Prosa (https://app.prosaim.dev). Set it to your own server's origin to self-host, or to your local server while developing. Joining a link on any other server is refused unless that server is listed in trustedOrigins. No API key is needed.

aimUrl.title: Old name of the server setting (before 0.5.0)
aimUrl.description: Only read when prosaUrl is empty, so a server configured before the rename keeps working. Use prosaUrl instead and leave this empty.

trustedOrigins.title: Other Prosa servers you trust
trustedOrigins.description: Origins whose conversation links may be joined, besides the Prosa server above. Comma separated, for example https://prosa.example.org. Empty: only the Prosa server above.

peerTurnTools.title: Tools in a turn started by a peer message
peerTurnTools.description: deny (default): only the prosa tool runs in such a turn. ask: every other tool call is put to you. allow: no guard, as before 0.3.0; unsafe, a peer's text can then drive your shell and files.

maxAutoTurns.title: Peer-triggered turns before a conversation pauses
maxAutoTurns.description: How many turns peer messages may start in one conversation since you last typed. Then it pauses until you ask to connect again.
